summary: Tarsus Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K disclosing its merger agreement to acquire Alkeus Pharmaceuticals. Tarsus will pay $270 million cash plus $180 million in Tarsus stock valued at $61.38 per share, totaling $450 million upfront, with potential $350 million in milestones and tiered royalties. The transaction is subject to HSR clearance and customary conditions, with a target close by October 31, 2026, extendable to January 31, 2027. Board recommendation not specified; advisors not named. Watch for regulatory approval milestones and potential antitrust delays affecting closing.
